texts.en:
Thanks to our efforts in furtively delving into their network systems, we were able to secure enough data for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to translate the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to successfully open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

We were also able to analyze the technical data we copied over from them, and found out some novel new approaches to physics problems that had not occurred to our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] before now.
